image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a black audio cassette tape. The image focuses on the central window showing the magnetic tape and the two spool hubs. A handwritten pink label is affixed to the top portion of the cassette shell. The bottom section shows the rectangular opening for the tape head and several small circular indentations (molded details).
